Sarah (AE): heads-up — Acme POC moving to contract. They want to sign via POA for their EU subsidiary. Need legal + finance path and to confirm e-sign + PO binding in that jurisdiction. attaching redline pdf later.
Lisa (Legal): can you paste the redline snippet inline? who is the counterparty legal contact? any KMS/HSM requirements in the DPA we should know about?
Sarah (AE): counterparty = Acme EU Holdings Ltd (registered in Ireland). They explicitly requested HSM-backed KMS and an attestation clause. Redline snippet below:
```
Section 7.2 (data processing): "Customer requires keys to be stored and managed within the EEA using HSM-backed KMS. Redwood shall provide a written attestation of HSM deployment and key custody procedures within 10 business days of request."
```
Devon (Security): HSM attestation is a pretty advanced ask. We can support HSM-backed keys for Private deployments or Dedicated with BYOK/HSM partner. Hosted API + standard hosting = we provide encryption in transit+at rest but not third-party HSM attestation. We'll need to mark this as a deployment constraint on the orderform and discuss options with customer.
Omar (FinOps): quick finance checks — what's the billing entity? Net terms? VAT handling? If we invoice Acme EU Holdings Ltd, VAT applies and they need a PO number to bind an orderform. Also will they accept Net30? need to confirm before routing signature.
Lisa (Legal): to accept a POA signer for the EU entity we need the POA doc (notarized or equivalent), plus signer's ID/eID. Preferred: notarized POA or eID scheme like eIDAS advanced. If they want pure DocuSign, we need an attached certified POA PDF. We should list acceptable proofs on the addendum.
Sarah (AE): I'll ask them for notarized POA or certified eID. They indicated they'd prefer DocuSign. I'll push for DocuSign + attached POA scan.
esig-bot: Envelope created (env_0xabc123) for orderform + MSA addendum -> awaiting signatures :email:
Lisa (Legal): draft proposal: minimal addendum requiring (1) PO reference, (2) attached POA doc (notarized or eIDAS), (3) if HSM attestation is required, orderform must specify "Private deployment or Dedicated with BYOK/HSM partner." also propose fallback: "If POA not received within 14 days of countersignature request, Redwood reserves the right to terminate the orderform." thoughts? :thinking:
Devon (Security): LGTM. Also add a line: "Security attestation timeline subject to product ops availability; may require SOW for HSM attestation." avoids promising immediate attestation.
Omar (FinOps): fine from billing side. Once we have PO number and billing entity, FinOps will create invoice. If they want VAT-exempt handling, send VAT reg number.
Sarah (AE): perfect. I'll escalate to Acme legal + procurement now, ask for POA + PO number, and confirm whether they need HSM attestation or will accept BYOK. I'll drop the redline pdf in this thread when they reply.
Lisa (Legal): thanks — please include the counterparty legal contact and expected signing timeline. I'll standby to finalize addendum.
Sarah (AE): will do. pinging @AcmeProcurement email (off-thread) as well. :pray:
